heroMeta: 87 public forecasts · no market prices consulted · publicly Brier-scored · forecast time
subChampion: Who lifts the trophy on July 19, 2026? Title probabilities for all 48 teams, generated by our forecasting agent: an Elo prior run through 100,000 Monte-Carlo tournament simulations, then Bayesian-updated with key evidence — injuries, squads, form — without ever consulting a market price.
subGroups: All 72 group-stage matches: win / draw / loss probabilities and the model's pick for every fixture. Open any match for the key reasons and full reasoning.
subKnockout: The complete run from group qualification to the final: every knockout node takes the most likely result with its per-tie win probability, lines running all the way to the final.
ruleNote: Format: the top two in every group advance to the round of 32, joined by the 8 best third-placed teams across the 12 groups — so each group sends 2 or 3 teams through.
marginalTitle: Marginal probabilities (per team, complementary to the single bracket path above)
cloudNote: Flag size ∝ title probability · click for full reasoning
sampleHint: Pick a real question to see the agent's actual output
formulaLegend: ν = 0.7 (draw parameter) · R is the live Elo rating · Δ is the evidence-driven bounded shift (|Δ| ≤ 8pp per match, renormalized)

peSub: The same pipeline behind our 87 published forecasts: an Elo prior, 100,000 Monte-Carlo simulations, and Bayesian updates from key evidence — never a single market price.
betaDesc: Enter the beta password to open the Deep Research console.
peStep1Copy: Any match, group winner, or title odds. You ask; the forecasting agent does the rest.
peStep2Copy: Public data gathered by priority: recent national-team results, club form, injuries and lineups, environment (venue, altitude, weather). Every fact dated and sourced; odds pages discarded on sight.
peStep3Copy: Live Elo feeds a Davidson three-way model for matches; qualification and title questions run 100,000 Monte-Carlo tournament simulations on the official bracket.
peStep4Copy: Key evidence becomes a bounded shift on the prior: at most ±8 points per match, nothing moves without evidence; every output carries a confidence tier.
peStep5Copy: Multilingual reports with full sources and methods; every question Brier-scored in public after settlement — wrong calls stay on record.
